title: Text-Only LLM Correctors Break Correct Transcripts: A Repair-Damage Analysis of Audio Grounding in ASR Error Correction
abstract: arXiv:2610.30385v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM correctors of ASR output are judged by aggregate WER, which hides what they fix and what they break. We decompose every WER change exactly into repaired tokens, damaged tokens and insertions, and use this to ask what the source audio adds to a corrector. We compare correction with and without the audio, for the model's own draft and for the output of an independent recogniser, on three corpora. With Gemini 2.5 Flash, text-only correction of its own draft breaks 13-32% of already-correct transcripts; with the audio, 1-3%. Damage falls in both settings. Repair falls against the own draft and rises against the recogniser. On medical dictation, kept insertions cancel the gain in net WER. The open-weight Voxtral, which rarely edits, does not show this pattern. Prompts differ between the two arms, so the contrasts bound the effect of the audio and do not isolate it.

translated_title: 纯文本LLM纠错器会破坏正确的转录文本：ASR纠错中音频信息锚定的修复-损伤分析
translated_abstract: 对ASR输出进行纠错的LLM纠错器通常以总体WER来评价，这掩盖了它们修复了什么、又破坏了什么。我们将每次WER变化精确分解为修复的词元、损伤的词元和插入，并利用这一分解探究源音频为纠错器带来了什么增益。我们在三个语料库上，分别针对模型自身的草稿和独立识别器的输出，比较了有无音频条件下的纠错表现。使用Gemini 2.5 Flash时，纯文本纠错其自身草稿会破坏13-32%本已正确的转录文本；而加入音频后仅为1-3%。在两种设置下损伤均下降，但对自身草稿的修复下降，而对识别器输出的修复上升。在医疗听写场景中，被保留的插入抵消了净WER的收益。很少进行编辑的开源权重模型Voxtral则未表现出这种模式。由于两个实验分支使用了不同的提示词，这些对比只能界定音频作用的范围，而无法将其单独分离出来。
tldr: 该论文提出将WER变化精确分解为修复、损伤与插入的修复-损伤分析框架，首次系统量化揭示了纯文本LLM纠错会破坏13-32%本已正确的转录文本，而引入音频信息后破坏率降至1-3%，证明音频锚定对ASR纠错具有关键的保护作用。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a repair-damage decomposition of WER changes, revealing that text-only LLM correctors break 13-32% of already-correct transcripts while audio-grounded correction breaks only 1-3%, demonstrating the critical protective role of audio grounding in ASR error correction.
